description.text: The tower has a flat top, its roof roomy enough for a crowd and an airship. Its top floor is a stately penthouse whose bedroom suite opens onto a balcony above the city, high enough that stars show even on misty nights. Wax fitted metal structures to the outside to help with steelpushing.

items.text: Waxillium Ladrian bought a share in the tower. Its penthouse stood empty while the people living there were away in Elmsdel on a long holiday.

Returning to Elendel aboard a Southern Scadrian airship, Wax, Steris Harms, Marasi Colms and Wayne set down on the roof, where Governor Claude Aradel and Constable-General Reddi met them. Worn out, Wax gave Aradel only a brief account and put off the full story until the next day.

Wax brought Steris downstairs, where a Survivorist priest was standing by in the penthouse. He asked her to marry him for love rather than as a contract between their houses; she said yes, they wed that same night and spent the whole of their honeymoon there.
After that stay, Wax thought about leaving Ladrian mansion to live in the tower for good, seeing skyscrapers as the mark of a newer, livelier age.
